title: Mixed Event — The Moon Rabbit & Us — Episode5 Rabbit Dango

meta.Event Outline: With MORE MORE JUMP!'s next stream approaching, Shizuku starts thinking of autumn-themed ideas, triggering childhood memories of when she went moon viewing with Shiho. She invites her sister to go together once again...

rows.Speaker: Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, let's start making some dango!
I hope we all get to have some cute and delicious ones!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
Yours look good too.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (I really want to make dango with her but...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (She probably wants to play with her friends since she's with me so much...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: That's okay. I can just make some on my own...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: So I dust it with this powder and...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (Making them nice and round is harder than I thought, but...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: They look cute when they do turn out right...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (I know. I can make it rounder, give it some ears and turn it into a bunny.)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: And now for some ears and... Hehe, it's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartener A
rows.Line:
Shiho, wait!
Your dango looks funny...

rows.Speaker: Kindergartener B
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll show you how to make them, so let's try together!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
That's okay...
Please, leave me alone.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartener A
rows.Line: But yours are gonna look different from what the teacher made.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: I don't care. I want to make mine like this.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (It's not as fun when I'm with everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (So I'll just keep making them by my...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Are your dango supposed to be bunnies? They're so cute.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind showing me how to make bunnies like yours?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: You should be with your friends, Shizuku. I'll keep making dango by myself.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Making dango with everyone else was fun, but I want to make some with you now.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: And you're the only one here who knows how to make adorable bunny dango.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I want to make some with you.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please, Shii.
Will you show me how to make these?

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: So how did you make these bunnies?

rows.Speaker: Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: That concludes our moon viewing party! Did you all get a chance to make some cute and delicious dango?

rows.Speaker: Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Wonderful! Don't forget to show your parents these delicious creations when you get home!

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Your dango turned out so cute, Shii. I'm sure mommy, daddy and grandma will love to see them.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's show them as soon as we can.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line:
Your mother's running very late...
I wonder if work is holding her up.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line:
Yes, she is...
Oh, someone's calling me. Excuse me, dear.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line:
Oh my. Really...?
You poor thing...

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line:
Understood.
I can handle making dinner, so you won't have to worry about that. Just get home safe, okay?

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, dear.
Your mother won't be home until much later.

rows.Speaker: Grandmother
rows.Line: Your father won't be home for quite some time either, so how about we show them the dango you made tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (I really wanted them to see what we made now...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm okay...
Let's go home, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (She's probably sad about this too, so I shouldn't pout or whine about this too much...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: You don't have to hold it in like that, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Whenever you feel sad, it's okay to say so.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: I won't ever feel sad as long as you're around, Shii. Not ever.

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: So just for today, I'll take mommy's place. You can tell me how you feel and ask me for whatever you like, okay?

rows.Speaker: Little Shizuku
rows.Line: Being there for you is what makes me happy because I'm your big sister.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (After that, Shizuku, grandma and I had dinner together... Then we showed mom and dad the dango we made once they got home.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And because Shizuku waited with me the whole time, I felt strangely at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, that's also sort of when she started being all clingy with me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe doing a moon viewing with her after all this time isn't such a bad idea...
